### Problem

The release candidate v7.19.0 fails the release scenario `bug-by-person-merges` in what the engine did: its `until` or `expect` did not hold, or could no longer hold, so the lane releases nothing and `v7` stays where it is.
Reproduced by: https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/44642022228 scenario `bug-by-person-merges`.

The step that fails is the `expect` (state CLOSED): in the lane's run https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/44646016354 the scenario reached every `until` (needs-info, accepted, the PRD seal, the `fix/3052-` pull request DiluxOne/diluxone-test#3088), and the pull request never merged. The test repository's auto-merge decision said "A human merges this one: the description does not match the code." The review of #3088 judged the fixed change as if it were a real fix: "The diff only adds a three-line markdown placeholder ... It fixes no misspelling ... C1 therefore has no test that proves it", and set `description_matches` false. The fixed change (kinds/engine-test/pack.yml `fixed-change`, `fixed_spec` in scripts/autopilot.py) is meant to be exactly that, one marker file per criterion written with no model, so a model's reading of it is the wrong thing for G7 to wait on. The fix I recommend is deterministic, like #879's for the required check: in the test repository whose pack says `autopilot: fixed-change`, G7 does not hold a pull request whose only changed files are its fixed change's files on the review's `description_matches`, and the review profile (kinds/engine-test/review-profile.md) says a fixed change's pull request matches its description by construction. A test feeds `decide` a record with `description_matches: false` for such a pull request and asserts it merges by policy, and that any other changed file still needs the description to match.

### Scope

- The cause of the failure above, in the engine, fixed with a test that would have caught it.

### Out of scope

- Changing the gates or what they check.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given v7.19.0's candidate with the fix, when the release lane plays `bug-by-person-merges` in the test repository, then it passes and the lane releases it.

### Criticality

Critical
